==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|copy|right|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɑpiˌɹaɪt/|a=GenAm}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒpiˌɹaɪt/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-copyright.ogg|a=US}}
* {{homophones|en|copywrite}}
* {{hyphenation|en|copy|right}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪt|s=3}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-|s}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The right by law to be the entity which determines who may publish, copy and distribute a piece of writing, music, picture or other work of authorship.
#: {{ux|en|'''Copyright''' is a separate legal area from trademarks.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=1949|author={{w|Friedrich Hayek|F. A. Hayek}}|title=The Intellectuals and Socialism|journal={{w|University of Chicago Law Review}}|publisher={{w|University of Chicago}}|location={{w|Chicago}}|volume=16|number=3|doi=10.2307/1597903|page=420|passage=One of the important points that would have to be examined in such a discussion would be how far the growth of this class has been artificially stimulated by the law of '''copyright'''.<sup>1</sup>}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} Such an exclusive right as it pertains to one or more specific works.
#: {{ux|en|The artist lost the '''copyrights''' to her songs when she signed the contract.}}
#: {{ux|en|The images are still '''copyright''' of the original artist.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Bill Mears|title=Justices allow copyrights on foreign works|url=https://www.cnn.com/2012/01/18/justice/scotus-copyrights-foreign-works/index.html|date=2012-01-18|passage=The 1994 law in question was designed to put the United States in compliance with global treaties on intellectual property– the Berne Convention and the so-called Uruguay Round. The federal legislation created '''copyrights''' to foreign works that had not previously been covered.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20201010021850/https://www.cnn.com/2012/01/18/justice/scotus-copyrights-foreign-works/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|informal|nonstandard}} A [[violation]] of copyright law; [[copyright infringement]].
#: {{co|en|no '''copyright''' intended}}

===Verb===
{{anchor|en-v}}
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|intransitive}} To obtain or secure a copyright for some literary or other artistic work.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1907 |title=District of Columbia Appropriations|author=United States Congress House. Committee on Appropriations |page=253 |ISBN= |passage= Every book will be '''copyrighted''' that the publisher believes will have such a market as will justify him in going to the expense of '''copyrighting''' to prevent competition from other publishers.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1993 |title=The Beast at Work|author=Gyeorgos Ceres Hatonn |page=161 |ISBN=156935006X |passage=Further, Mr. Mullins writes FOR YOU-THE-PEOPLE, '''copyrighting''' to protect listings and to make a statement—but willingly shares his work for, after all, if it is not read then of what worth is a book? }}
#* '''2002''', ''{{w|Spider-Man (2002 film)|Spider-Man}}'' (film)
# {{lb|en|transitive|informal|nonstandard}} To [[flag]] for copyright violation, to [[copystrike]].
#: {{ux|en|I won’t play this track, I don’t wanna get '''copyrighted'''.}}
